Hi Alicia — great to chat. Below is a concise recommendation and proposed next steps so your team can start an evaluation quickly. I attached a starter prompt set and our most recent RAG benchmark CSV.

TL;DR recommendations (first-pass POC):
- Generation model(s): "redwood-llama-13b-q4" (primary) and "redwood-llama-7b-q4" (fast-fallback). These balance quality vs cost for knowledge-heavy Q/A.
- Embedding model: "redwood-embed-4" (semantic) for high recall plus cosine similarity.
- Retriever: dense vector search (FAISS/HNSW) with chunk size ~ 500 tokens, overlap 50 tokens. Index strategy: per-document chunking with metadata fields for doc-type and publish-date.
- Reranker: cross-encoder ("cross-encoder-mpnet-v2") as a post-retrieval reranker; thresholded to only re-rank top 50 candidates to control latency.
- Retrieval tuning: start with top_k=50 (retrieve), rerank top_n=12, softmax temperature tuning at generation layer = 0.2 for grounding.

Grounding & regression monitoring (what to track):
- Grounding rate = fraction of model answers citing one or more retrieved chunks. Aim: > 92% in POC.
- Hallucination rate (manual sample-based) — baseline expected 6-12% on our benchmark; if >15% we escalate prompt/iterator.
- MRR / Top-1 accuracy on your labeled benchmark set (we'll provide an eval harness).
- Latency (P50/P95) by route and model variant.

Attachments: acme-rag-prompt-sets-v2.md, redwood-rag-benchmarks-20261005.csv

Proposed next steps:
1) Redwood provides a benchmark harness + seed prompt set (attached) and a small data ingestion playbook.
2) You run ingestion on a 5-10k doc sample (we can help).
3) We run two model variants (13b/q4 and 7b/q4) with the retrieval+rerank config above and share the CSV results and a notebook with metrics.
4) 1-week sync to review results and decide production path (Dedicated vs Hosted).

If you want, Neha will scope the baseline run (expected tokens and estimated cost) and Dylan will add specific FAISS/embedding config notes.

— Marissa

Adding a few technical specifics from the SE side to make the POC reproducible:

- Embeddings: redwood-embed-4; batch embeddings at 1024/doc ops to keep throughput high. Store vectors in HNSW with ef_construction 200, ef_search 64.
- Chunking: 500 token chunks with 50-token overlap gives good context fidelity for long HTML docs; use sentence-boundary aware chunking to avoid splits.
- Retriever tuning: start with semantic search (cosine) + BM25 hybrid for edge cases (we surface BM25 when semantic score < 0.15).
- Reranker latency: cross-encoder rerank for top_n=12 adds ~60-110ms depending on hardware; if P95 latency is violated, fall back to a bi-encoder similarity with a conservative threshold.
- Evaluation metrics: we'll compute grounding rate, MRR, top-1 precision, and a small manual hallucination audit of 200 examples. We'll provide the eval harness (notebook + NL eval script).

Estimated sample run (10k docs, ~1.2M tokens):
- Embedding cost (redwood-embed-4): estimated ~ $120-160.
- Inference runs (13b q4): estimate ~ $900-1,200 for the benchmark run (dependent on throughput).

I'll prepare a short runbook for ingestion and share as soon as you confirm the sample dataset.

Hi Alicia — quick answers and links below.

1) Latency: baseline we expect 13b q4 + cross-encoder rerank (top_n=12) to be close to your P95 800ms target in Dedicated or optimized hosted with GPU backends; on general-purpose hosted nodes you may see P95 ~900-1100ms. For strict P95 <800ms at production traffic, start with the 7b variant as primary and treat 13b as quality test/upgrade path. We can also configure a progressive routing policy: route 95% to 7b and 5% to 13b for quality sampling.

2) Links & files:
- Benchmark CSV (latest): https://drive.google.com/file/d/redwood-rag-benchmarks-20261005.csv
- Eval harness (notebook + script): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-acme-rag
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/ACME-2026-01

Cost ballpark for 2-week POC (10k-doc sample):
- Embeddings & ingestion: $150-200
- Benchmark inference (13b q4 run across sample): $900-1,200 (one-time run)
- SE time / onboarding: $4,000 (estimated professional services, optional)
